effects.description: (4 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) When you deal damage, you call a murder of crows around you for |cffffff12|r seconds. Every |cffffff3|r seconds a crow will be sent to peck the closest enemy within |cffffff12|r meters of you, dealing |cffffff871|r Physical Damage. This effect can occur once every |cffffff15|r seconds and scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage.
